subject: How to revert legend colors and labels

messages.author: 86926f18c37b8fdc
messages.subject: How to revert legend colors and labels
parts:
I have noticed similar discussions in the list but didn't find a
satisfactory answer. Consider the following code:

da <- data.frame(x=factor(1:5), a=seq(0.1,0.9,0.2), b=seq
(0.9,0.1,-0.2))
daa <- melt(da, id="x", variable_name="bin")
p <- ggplot(daa, aes(x))
mycol <- c("blue","red")
p + geom_bar(aes(weight=value, fill=bin)) + scale_colour_manual
(values=mycol)

The resulting bars have blue over red and the legend has red ("a")
over blue ("b"). How do I make the legend show blue("b") over red
("a"), to be in the same order as the bars? I tried
value=rev(mycol), breaks = c("b","a")
to no effect.

Thanks,

Roberto

(btw you meant scale_fill_manual above, I'm sure).

> The resulting bars have blue over red and the legend has red ("a")
> over blue ("b"). How do I make the legend show blue("b") over red
> ("a"), to be in the same order as the bars? I tried
> value=rev(mycol), breaks = c("b","a")
> to no effect.

This also doesn't help:

daa$bin <- factor(daa$bin,levels=c("b","a"), ordered=T)

You can swap around which color is drawn on top that way (red over
blue), but the legend swaps as well, so that it is the opposite of
what you want (which is the legend in the same order as the stacked
bars).

Hopefully others have the answer.

--J

It looks like a bug in scale_manual. Breaks should control the legend
order, as in the following example:

p + geom_bar(aes(weight=value, fill=bin)) + scale_fill_hue(breaks=c("b","a"))
p + geom_bar(aes(weight=value, fill=bin)) + scale_fill_hue(breaks=c("a","b"))

I'll it to my to do list.
